name: beatupbuddy
title: hype up buddy
blurb: a physics ragdoll wearing @mfzx.net's real avatar as its head, standing on a weighted base — pick a tool and shower them in confetti and love, they wobble and dance and light up more with every hit. started life as a "beat up a buddy" game; turned positive at @bisks.net's request once @mfzx.net said they weren't thrilled with the original.
